messages:
maya (oncall): SEV2 page — tokenizer-service spikes 5xx for /embed (35% error rate). Noticed after a small config push at ~12:11 UTC. Routing autoscaler kept retrying and amplifying errors. Paging SRE now.
ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0421-73 (SEV2). Paging: @Nate - SRE, @lexa (prod-eng), @Sam G. Timeline logging enabled.
pagerduty-bot: Alert: tokenizer-service error rate > 20% for 5m. Triggering escalation policy.
Nate - SRE: on it. grabbing logs and snapshotting the GC/heap metrics. Initial theory: tokenizer process OOM/restarts or stuck event loop.
maya (oncall): I routed 25% traffic to fallback tokenizer v1.8 (stateless) to reduce pressure. Latency looks stable but embedding error rate only down to 18% — still above threshold.
Sam G: Can we take 100% to fallback while we diagnose? Need to minimize customer impact. Any feature toggles?
lexa (prod-eng): We have a fast route switch: run `redwoodctl route modify tokenizer-service --fallback v1.8 --weight 100` . I'm standing by to apply if SRE agrees.
Nate - SRE: do it. Also bump the concurrency limit on the pooling layer by 30% (temp). Running: `k scale deploy tokenizer --replicas=6` and `redis-cli CONFIG SET maxclients 20000` — watching threads.
maya (oncall): Applied route change at 12:23 UTC. Customer 5xxs dropped to ~2% within 2 min. Rolling back slower config push now.
ops-bot: note: rollback detected for deploy tokenizer-config:deploy-2026-0421-3 at 12:25 UTC (initiated by maya (oncall)).
lexa (prod-eng): Good call to rollback. Let's capture the failing binary and collate logs for a post-incident. Nate, can you attach the last 1h of stderr/stdout and core dumps to INC-2026-0421-73?
Nate - SRE: uploading to the incident folder now: s3://redwood-incidents/INC-2026-0421-73/artifacts.tar.gz . Added pointers to heap profiles and strace samples.
maya (oncall): Quick customer impact note: ~3% of requests affected, primarily embeddings and batch batch-create flows. No data loss. Major customers: two mid-market tenants saw elevated errors for ~12 minutes. Notified account reps.
Sam G: Thanks. We should schedule a postmortem. Propose 2026-04-22 16:00 UTC. Who can own?
lexa (prod-eng): I'll co-own the postmortem (root cause: config change + poor telemetry on tokenizer mem growth). Nate, can you add the SRE timeline and mitigation steps?
Nate - SRE: will add timeline + mitigation & diagnostics.
maya (oncall): Action list I propose (assign owners here):
- Create postmortem doc and invite stakeholders (owner: lexa) — TKT-3421
- Add automatic memory-util alert for tokenizer > 70% over 3m (owner: Nate) — TKT-3422
- Add pre-deploy smoke for tokenizer that runs a short embedding workload (owner: prod-eng runbook) — TKT-3423
- Update runbook with explicit fallback routing commands + quick checklist (owner: maya) — TKT-3424
- Add canary rollout gating to the config deploy pipeline (owner: eng-platform) — TKT-3425
Please add owners/estimates if you disagree.
ops-bot: Action items created: TKT-3421, TKT-3422, TKT-3423, TKT-3424, TKT-3425.
Sam G: For the runbook update, suggest adding a short code block with the exact commands and the rollback checklist. Example snippet: 
```
# temporary: route 100% to fallback
redwoodctl route modify tokenizer-service --fallback v1.8 --weight 100
# scale SRE pool
kubectl scale deploy/tokenizer --replicas=6
# verify
redwoodctl metrics query --service tokenizer --window 5m --metric error_rate
```
Nate - SRE: Also include a step to capture pprof/heap and mention where to upload (incident S3 path). Add `gcore` and `strace -f -o /tmp/strace.out <pid>` examples.
maya (oncall): Agreed. I'll draft runbook change and push a PR to infra/runbooks/tokenizer-playbook.md. PR will include: threshold values, exact commands, who to page, and an explicit handoff checklist (see below).
maya (oncall): Proposed handoff checklist (to add to runbook):
- Summary of state + what was done
- Live mitigations in place (routes, scales)
- Open artifacts + links
- Customer impact summary + notified reps
- Action items + ticket links
- Next oncall & postmortem owner
lexa (prod-eng): Good. For postmortem scheduling: 2026-04-22 16:00 UTC works for me. Sam, Nate, maya please RSVP.
Sam G: Confirmed.
Nate - SRE: Confirmed.
ops-bot: Postmortem meeting created: INC-2026-0421-73-PM at 2026-04-22T16:00:00Z. Calendar invites sent to participants.
maya (oncall): Before we close this thread: two follow-ups for runbook text. 1) Add a 'when to bypass autoscaler' note (temporary manual scaling guidance). 2) Add a short blameless language template for the postmortem intro. I'll open PR shortly and link here.
lexa (prod-eng): Nice. Also let's add a short test in CI that verifies fallback route switch works (end-to-end smoke) — ticket TKT-3426.
Sam G: Nice catch. Add me as reviewer on the runbook PR.
maya (oncall): Closing ops summary: mitigation succeeded, rollback performed, customer impact limited, postmortem scheduled. Moving action items to TKT board. If anyone spots missing items ping here or add directly to the tickets. :white_check_mark: :spiral_calendar:
ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-0421-73 marked as triaged.
pagerduty-bot: All on-call pages cleared.
maya (oncall): thanks team — great work responding quickly.
notes: post-incident coordination, handoff checklist, runbook edits, action-ticket creation
